seoTitle: What is Jawab24? | Arabic-First AI Auto-Reply for WhatsApp, Facebook, Instagram, Shopify, Salla & Zid
seoDescription: Jawab24 is an Arabic-first AI auto-reply platform for businesses selling through WhatsApp, Facebook, Instagram, Shopify, Salla, and Zid. It automatically replies to customer comments and messages in the customer’s language, syncs product catalogs, and uses a 3-layer reply system with built-in price verification. Free trial available.
title: What is Jawab24?

intro.title: What is Jawab24?
intro.text: Jawab24 is an AI-powered auto-reply platform built specifically for Arabic-speaking and bilingual businesses. It connects to Facebook Pages, Instagram business accounts, WhatsApp Business numbers, and e-commerce stores on Shopify, Salla, and Zid, reads incoming comments and direct messages, and automatically replies to customers in their language — 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.
intro.text2: Jawab24 is not a chatbot — it is an intelligent auto-reply system designed for Arabic-first businesses. Unlike chatbots that follow rigid decision trees, Jawab24 understands context, recognizes Arabic dialect groups, integrates natively with Salla and Zid, and uses a built-in safety system to prevent the AI from inventing prices or unsupported facts. Every AI-generated reply passes through 6 automated post-validation checks before it is sent.

subtitle: Jawab24 is an AI auto-reply tool that helps businesses automatically reply to Facebook comments, Instagram and WhatsApp messages, and customer questions using artificial intelligence.

howItWorks.title: How Jawab24 Works
howItWorks.text: When a customer writes a comment on your Facebook post or sends a message to your page, Jawab24 processes it through a 3-layer reply system:
howItWorks.layer1Text: You configure post replies with keywords on specific posts. When a comment matches a keyword, the system sends your pre-written reply privately via DM. Fast, predictable, and free of AI cost.
howItWorks.layer2Text: If no post reply matches, the AI generates a custom reply based on your Business Info, product catalog, store policies, and conversation history. It uses advanced large language models to understand the customer's intent — whether they're asking about a product, filing a complaint, or just saying hello — and crafts a natural, on-brand response in the same language and dialect the customer used.
howItWorks.layer3Text: Outside your business hours — or when auto-reply is turned off — the system sends a friendly away message so your customers know you're not ignoring them.

platforms.title: Supported Platforms
platforms.text: As an official Meta Tech Provider, Jawab24 connects directly to the platforms where your customers are:
platforms.facebook: Facebook Pages — auto-reply to comments and Messenger messages
platforms.instagram: Instagram Business Accounts — auto-reply to comments and DMs
platforms.whatsapp: WhatsApp Business numbers — auto-reply to customer messages, voice notes included (Starter plan and up)
platforms.shopify: Shopify — sync your product catalog so the AI can answer product questions with accurate prices, descriptions, and availability
platforms.salla: Salla — sync your product catalog from Salla stores, the leading Arabic e-commerce platform
platforms.zid: Zid — sync your product catalog from Zid stores so replies quote real products and prices

knowledgeBase.title: Business Info
knowledgeBase.text: Your Business Info is your AI's brain. You write sections describing your business — return policy, shipping info, FAQs, product details — and the AI uses this information to generate accurate replies.
knowledgeBase.text2: The system uses RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) to find the most relevant knowledge for each customer question. This means the AI only uses information you've provided, reducing hallucination and keeping replies accurate.
knowledgeBase.feature1: Organize your Business Info into sections with titles and content
knowledgeBase.feature2: Version history — restore previous versions if needed
knowledgeBase.feature3: RAG-powered search finds the right context for each question
knowledgeBase.feature4: Product catalog from Shopify, Salla or Zid is automatically included

ecommerce.title: E-Commerce Integration
ecommerce.text: Jawab24 connects directly to your Shopify, Salla or Zid store to sync your product catalog. When a customer asks about a product, the AI can:
ecommerce.feature1: Answer with the correct price, description, and availability
ecommerce.feature2: Suggest relevant products based on the customer's question
ecommerce.feature3: Handle "how much is..." and "is this in stock?" questions automatically
ecommerce.feature4: Two-tier price hallucination detection: verifies every number adjacent to currency symbols (SAR, $, etc.) against your actual catalog, and catches price-cue phrases like "starts at" or "costs" followed by unverified numbers. If a price isn't in your catalog, the AI sends a safe fallback instead of a wrong price.

smartReply.title: Smart Reply Features
smartReply.text: The AI-powered Smart Reply system goes far beyond simple keyword matching. In internal testing across 125 real-world scenarios — including Arabic dialects, sarcasm detection, price questions, complaints, and edge cases — Jawab24 achieved 99.6% evaluation accuracy:
smartReply.feature1: Understands 6 Arabic dialect families (Gulf, Egyptian, Levantine, Maghrebi, Iraqi, and Modern Standard Arabic) plus mixed Arabic-English messages
smartReply.feature2: Classifies every message into 8 intent categories: question, compliment, complaint, purchase intent, greeting, business inquiry, offensive, or spam
smartReply.feature3: Adjustable reply style: Professional, Casual, or Enthusiastic — with optional brand voice notes to match your tone
smartReply.feature4: Three-level confidence scoring (high, medium, low) — low-confidence replies are automatically held for human review instead of being sent
smartReply.feature5: Full conversation context — the AI reads previous messages and consolidates rapid-fire messages into a single coherent reply
smartReply.feature6: Customer awareness — recognizes returning customers by name, remembers past conversation topics, and adjusts its greeting accordingly

postReply.title: Post Replies
postReply.text: For specific posts, you can configure keyword-triggered replies sent privately via DM:
postReply.feature1: Set keywords on a post (e.g., "price", "link", "address") that trigger an instant DM
postReply.feature2: Instant response with zero AI cost — saves your smart reply credits
postReply.feature3: Configured per-post directly from the comments page
postReply.feature4: Perfect for promotions, lead capture, and ManyChat-style engagement on Instagram and Facebook

bilingual.title: Bilingual Support
bilingual.text: Jawab24 is designed for Arabic-first businesses that also serve English-speaking customers:
bilingual.feature1: Full Arabic and English interface with RTL layout support
bilingual.feature2: Smart Replies match the customer's language automatically
bilingual.feature3: Greeting and away messages are auto-translated to both languages
bilingual.feature4: Business Info content works in both languages

businessHours.title: Business Hours & Away Messages
businessHours.feature1: Set business hours for each day of the week
businessHours.feature2: Auto-reply activates during business hours, away message outside
businessHours.feature4: Away messages auto-translated to Arabic and English

analytics.title: Dashboard & Analytics
analytics.text: Monitor your auto-reply performance from a unified dashboard:
analytics.feature1: See all comments and messages across all connected pages
analytics.feature2: Track which replies are AI-generated vs post replies vs manual
analytics.feature3: View conversation threads with full context
analytics.feature4: Filter by page, date, reply type, and read/unread status

mobile.title: Mobile App
mobile.text: Jawab24 is available as a mobile app for Android (iOS coming soon). The mobile app gives you full access to your dashboard, settings, and conversations — with real-time push notifications when customers message you. You get immediate alerts when the AI flags an angry customer, detects a low-confidence reply that needs your review, or encounters a question it can't answer from your Business Info.

security.title: Security & Privacy
security.feature1: OAuth 2.0 authentication through Facebook — we never store your Facebook password
security.feature2: All data encrypted in transit (HTTPS) and at rest
security.feature3: GDPR-compliant data handling with full data deletion support
security.feature4: Sentry error tracking for reliability monitoring

whoShouldUse.title: Who Should Use Jawab24?
whoShouldUse.user1: E-commerce store owners on Shopify, Salla or Zid who get frequent product questions
whoShouldUse.user2: Facebook Page managers who receive high volumes of comments and messages
whoShouldUse.user3: Small businesses that can't afford a 24/7 customer support team
whoShouldUse.user4: Arabic-speaking businesses that need a tool built for their language
whoShouldUse.user5: Social media managers handling multiple pages

pricing.title: Pricing Overview
pricing.text: Jawab24 offers a free trial with no credit card required. Paid plans start with a Starter tier for small pages and scale up to Business and Enterprise tiers for high-volume businesses. All plans include AI smart replies, post replies, Business Info with RAG search, and e-commerce integration. Post replies are included in every plan at no extra cost and never count against your Smart Reply limit. See the pricing page for current plan details and limits.

getStarted.title: Get Started
getStarted.text: Getting started with Jawab24 takes less than 2 minutes:
getStarted.step1: Sign up with your Facebook account
getStarted.step2: Connect your Facebook Pages and Instagram accounts
getStarted.step4: Turn on auto-reply — Jawab24 handles the rest

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.a1: Jawab24 offers a free trial. After the trial, paid plans are available starting at an affordable monthly rate. All plans include AI smart replies and post replies.
faq.q2: Does Jawab24 work with Instagram and WhatsApp?
faq.a2: Yes. Jawab24 supports Facebook Pages and Instagram Business Accounts on all plans, and WhatsApp Business numbers on the Starter plan and up. It auto-replies to comments and direct messages, all from one shared inbox.
faq.a3: Yes. Jawab24 is built for Arabic-first businesses. The AI understands Arabic (including dialects), replies in Arabic, and the entire interface supports right-to-left layout.
faq.q4: Does it integrate with Shopify, Salla and Zid?
faq.a4: Yes. You can connect your Shopify, Salla or Zid store to sync your product catalog. The AI uses your product information to answer customer questions with accurate prices and availability.
faq.a5: Jawab24 uses confidence scoring. When the AI is uncertain, it flags the reply for human review instead of sending an incorrect response. It also checks for hallucinated prices to ensure accuracy.
faq.q6: Can I control what the AI says?
faq.a6: Absolutely. You control the AI through your Business Info (what it knows), post replies (per-post keyword triggers for common questions), reply style settings (professional, casual, or enthusiastic), and business hours (when it's active).
faq.q7: How does Jawab24 handle Arabic dialects?
faq.a7: Jawab24's AI can recognize and reply in 6 Arabic dialect families: Gulf (Saudi, Emirati, Kuwaiti), Egyptian, Levantine (Syrian, Lebanese, Jordanian), Maghrebi (Moroccan, Tunisian, Algerian), Iraqi, and Modern Standard Arabic. It detects which dialect the customer is using and replies naturally in the same dialect. It also handles Franco-Arabic (Arabic written in Latin letters) and mixed Arabic-English messages.
faq.q8: Can Jawab24 answer product pricing questions from my Shopify, Salla or Zid store?
faq.a8: Yes. When you connect your Shopify, Salla or Zid store, Jawab24 automatically syncs your product catalog (names, prices, variants, and stock status) every 6 hours. When a customer asks "how much is the blue shirt?" the AI looks up the exact price from your catalog and replies with accurate information. If the product isn't in your catalog, the AI says "let me check" instead of guessing — it never makes up a price.
faq.q9: What happens when Jawab24 doesn't know the answer?
faq.a9: When the AI can't find an answer in your Business Info or product catalog, it assigns a low confidence score and responds with something like "Let me check with the team and get back to you." If you have the hold-low-confidence setting enabled, the reply is held for your manual review before being sent. The system also tracks which questions it can't answer, and after 3 occurrences of the same unanswered question, it notifies you so you can update your Business Info.
faq.a10: Yes. Jawab24 has native integration with Salla, the leading Arabic e-commerce platform. You connect your Salla store via OAuth, and Jawab24 automatically syncs your product catalog, prices, product availability, and store policies (shipping, returns, warranty). The AI uses this data to answer customer questions accurately. Salla tokens are automatically refreshed so the connection stays active.
faq.q11: Can I use Jawab24 for multiple Facebook pages?
faq.a11: Yes. You can connect multiple Facebook Pages and Instagram Business Accounts to a single Jawab24 workspace. Each page has its own Business Info content, and post replies are configured per-post on each page. The AI maintains separate context for each page, so replies are always relevant to the specific business.

whyDifferent.title: Why Jawab24 Is Different
whyDifferent.text: Jawab24 is not a chatbot — it is an intelligent auto-reply system. Traditional chatbots force you to build conversation flows manually and follow rigid decision trees. Jawab24 understands what customers are asking, checks your product catalog for accurate information, and generates natural responses — all without any flow setup. It combines post replies, AI-generated smart replies, product catalog data, and business knowledge into a single system that works in Arabic and English. Designed from the ground up for Arabic-speaking markets, with native Salla and Zid integration, dialect-aware AI, and right-to-left interface support.
